meta.name: ai-audit-website
meta.description: 网站诊断助手适合市场营销、运营、software、教育培训在用户提出“网站哪里拖后腿”这类问题，需要快速拆解目标、判断重点并形成可执行结果时使用，帮助基于输入材料生成研究摘要、关键发现、引用/验证清单。

copy.tagline: 快速诊断网站问题并生成可执行报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速找出网站短板并获取改进建议
copy.tagline_en: Quickly diagnose website issues and generate actionable reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly identify website weaknesses and get improvement suggestions

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成网站诊断助手。当你提供网站链接或问题描述，它会分析网站性能、可用性等，输出研究摘要、关键发现和引用清单。
howto.when: 当你提出“网站哪里拖后腿”这类问题，或需要分析网站性能、可用性、搜索、转化时触发。

say.text: 帮我诊断这个网站哪里拖后腿：https://example.com
say.note: Claude 会分析该网站并输出摘要和发现。

say.text: 分析这份 Lighthouse 报告，找出性能瓶颈。
say.note: 上传报告后，Claude 会提取关键指标并给出建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes a website audit assistant. When you provide a URL or problem description, it analyzes performance, usability, etc., and outputs a research summary, key findings, and a citation/verification checklist.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask "what's holding my website back" or need analysis of performance, usability, search, or conversion.

say_en.text: Audit this website for issues: https://example.com
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the site and output a summary and findings.

say_en.text: Analyze this Lighthouse report for performance bottlenecks.
say_en.note: Upload the report; Claude extracts key metrics and suggestions.
